basic_details.job_title: Davangere University Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Studies in Computer Science, Davangere University, is engaging one Project Assistant on a purely temporary contract at consolidated pay of Rs. 15,000/- per month under the AICTE – RPS Scheme project "Agrikavach: An IoT, Drone, and Robotics-Based Smart System for Protecting Farmland from Animal Intrusions and Wildfires". The initial term is 12 months, extendable up to 36 months. Candidates need an M.E. / M.Tech or M.Sc. in the listed fields and must apply on the prescribed form to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Chandrakant Naikodi, by the last date, which is 15 days from the

age_limit.details: The age limit is not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation of 5 years applies to candidates belonging to SC/ST/Women and Physically Challenged categories, and 3 years to the OBC category. Candidates must be Indian citizens. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: M.E. / M.Tech (CSE or equivalent) in Computer Science and Engg, Electronics & Communications, Robotics & Automation or a closely related discipline from a recognized University/Institute; OR M.Sc. in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field, with a minimum of 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA) in the qualifying degree.

how_to_apply: Take the Application Form for the post of Project Assistant (Contract Basis), enclosed on the last page of the notice. The advertisement says the form is also available on the official website.

Fill in the form: post applied for, name, parents' name, date of birth, gender, category, nationality, addresses, mobile number, e-mail ID, educational qualifications from 10th onwards, experience, technical skills and the list of enclosures.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph and self-attest it. Sign the declaration with place and date.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates/mark-sheets: educational qualification, date of birth, category certificate if applicable, and experience certificates if any.

Send the application to: The PI of AICTE – RPS Scheme, Dr. Chandrakant Naikodi, Professor, DoS in Computer Science, Davangere University, Davangere-577007. The advertisement gives the mobile number 9901452550.
Applications received after the last date, or incomplete applications, will not be considered.
Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates and mark-sheets
The form's enclosure list also names 10th and 12th certificates, degree certificate and mark-sheets, and a Statement of Purpose

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the minimum eligibility criteria as on the last date of application. M.E. / M.Tech (CSE or equivalent) in Computer Science and Engg, Electronics & Communications, Robotics & Automation or a closely related discipline from a recognized University/Institute; OR M.Sc. in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field, with a minimum of 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA) in the qualifying degree. Working knowledge of one or more of: IoT/embedded systems (Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32), sensor networks, drone/UAV hardware and flight-control software, robotics/automation, Python/C/C++/Embedded C programming, machine learning or computer-vision frameworks (TensorFlow/OpenCV), and basic electronics prototyping. Prior project/internship/academic experience in IoT, robotics, drone systems, precision agriculture, or wildlife/fire-monitoring technologies is an added advantage. Freshers with a strong academic project in a relevant area are also encouraged to apply. The age limit is not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation of 5 years applies to candidates belonging to SC/ST/Women and Physically Challenged categories, and 3 years to the OBC category. Candidates must be Indian citizens. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Assistant receives Rs. 15,000/- per month (consolidated, as per project sanction / institutional norms). The remuneration carries no other allowances such as DA, HRA, CCA, or other perquisites admissible to regular employees, unless explicitly stated in the project sanction order. The engagement is initially for 12 months from the date of joining. It is extendable/renewable based on performance, requirement and availability of project funds, up to the sanctioned duration of the project [36 months]. Extension is solely at the discretion of the Principal Investigator, subject to satisfactory performance, continued availability of project funds and approval of the funding agency.

content_sections.heading: Davangere University Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate works under the direct supervision and guidance of the Principal Investigator / Co-Principal Investigator(s) of the project. The duties printed in the notice are: Field deployment of IoT sensor nodes Drone-based surveillance Robotics-based deterrent systems Data collection and analysis Other project activities as assigned from time to time

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Davangere University Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date, or incomplete applications, will not be considered. Duly filled Application Form Recent passport-size photograph Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates and mark-sheets Date of birth proof Category certificate, if applicable Experience certificate(s), if any The form's enclosure list also names 10th and 12th certificates, degree certificate and mark-sheets, and a Statement of Purpose

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by shortlisting based on eligibility, followed by a Written Test / Technical Presentation / Personal Interview, as decided by the Selection Committee. The Selection Committee decides how many candidates are shortlisted. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not give a right to be called for a written test or interview. Shortlisted candidates are intimated by email/phone. No separate call letters are sent by post. The notice does not give a date or venue for the test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant posts has Davangere University announced?
faq.answer: Davangere University has announced 1 Project Assistant post under the AICTE – RPS Scheme project Agrikavach.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The notice gives the last date as 15 days from the date of advertisement. Counted from the notice dated 12 November 2026, that is about 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Davangere University Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The candidate needs an M.E. / M.Tech (CSE or equivalent) in Computer Science and Engg, Electronics & Communications, Robotics & Automation or a closely related discipline; OR an M.Sc. in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field, with a minimum of 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA) in the qualifying degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 35 years as on the last date of application. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST/Women and Physically Challenged candidates, and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 15,000/- per month, as per project sanction / institutional norms.

faq.question: Q6. Are DA and HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: No. The remuneration carries no DA, HRA, CCA or other perquisites unless explicitly stated in the project sanction order.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the filled Application Form with self-attested certificates and a passport-size photograph to the PI of AICTE – RPS Scheme, Dr. Chandrakant Naikodi, Professor, DoS in Computer Science, Davangere University, Davangere-577007.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on eligibility, followed by a Written Test / Technical Presentation / Personal Interview, as decided by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job and how long is the contract?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. It starts for 12 months and may be extended up to 36 months, and gives no right to regular employment.

faq.question: Q10. Is travel allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is paid for attending the written test/interview.
